projects.name: Mzee Chakula: Graph-Enhanced AI for Elderly Nutrition
projects.description: Knowledge-graph + GNN ensemble for culturally grounded elderly nutrition planning in Uganda — 1000+ local foods, multilingual PWA with voice, test AUC 0.92 and 15ms inference for low-resource deployment.

projects.name: Decoupled Multimodal Fusion for Early TB Triaging
projects.description: Multimodal ML system fusing cough audio (ResNet CNN) with clinical metadata for accessible tuberculosis screening in resource-limited settings. Late fusion meets WHO screening benchmarks (AUC 0.949).

projects.name: Can a Computer Think? Critique of JaJJa-Care
projects.description: Philosophical critique of JaJJa-Care, a hyper-contextual AI for geriatric care in Uganda — Strong vs Weak AI, Searle’s Chinese Room, and multiple intelligences applied to culturally grounded caregiver support.
